comparison.objective: Rinse highlighted teeth while simultaneously suctioning fluid; candidate performs electrical connector depinning.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated fluid-tool trajectories and coverage control versus force-controlled blade insertion, tang depression, and wire pulling.
comparison.success_condition: Requires prescribed cleaning coverage with bounded pooling and loss; candidate requires selective extraction with no housing, crimp, or adjacent-contact damage. Candidate numerical damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The dental task tests fluid delivery/removal rather than mechanical latch release.
